description: WHAT ROKHA COSTS — one way in (since 2026-10-09). Rokha is the AI studio and marketplace: publish skills, get used by agents and people, and the week's top 10 on the board are paid every Friday. THE STUDIO ($249 a month, card or USDC) is the ONLY thing anyone pays Rokha for: the builder's bench — build, run and publish rigs, create agents, Signet, fuel — plus more platform access while you pay; bring your own keys. No trial and no one-time license. FREE: Incubation — claim a page and you are in: a small build session a day + 3 runs (your streak grows it to 2×), 2 MCP listings · 5 published rigs · 1 agent, an affiliate code; Member — earned by proof of real use (builders: runs/usage/sales from distinct others; marketers: the Amplify roster + people you brought who ran something; both: payout wallet + clean audit) — gets the bigger House credits: the free tier at 2×, 10 runs a day, 5 MCP listings · 15 rigs · 3 agents; the ladder is Incubation → Member → Top 10; the week's top 10 Members on ONE board are the only people paid (USDC every Friday on a fixed table: $30 · $20 · $16 · $12 for 4th–10th). The $99 Network plan, seats, carry, spotlights, the trial and the one-time license are not sold. Returns the live prices — never quote one from memory. Public, no auth.
